review_basis: The target defect is incorrect SQL ordering for a self-referencing foreign key; 'avoid infinite loops' is only an existing nearby implementation comment.
The target defect is an IndexError in sqrtdenest; recursion wording occurs only in auxiliary discussion and is not the repaired failure.
The target defect is an uncaught PolynomialError; RecursionError is mentioned only in auxiliary discussion and is not the repaired failure.
The task adds mount-fact collection and timeout support for slow or unresponsive mount points; it does not repair an infinite loop or recursion.
After a WinRM stdin-write failure the connection keeps retrying output retrieval indefinitely; the patch adds a one-attempt exit path that breaks the retry loop.

Active sessions block on synchronous audit-event fanout to a slow or unresponsive emitter; the repair makes emission asynchronous. This is blocking/backpressure rather than an infinite loop or recursion.
The target defect is no_log sanitization changing dictionary-key names; recursion wording describes an implementation strategy for avoiding stack depth.
The target task unifies dropdown sizing. The floating-ui infinite-loop comment and border workaround already existed and were moved during the refactor, so they are not the repaired defect.
Book import can hang or time out while fetching covers from unsupported hosts; this is external I/O waiting and is fixed by host filtering, not by terminating a loop or recursion.
The patch introduces intentional payment-status polling; the loop is normal application behavior rather than the reported defect.
The target concerns locale parsing and blank pages; wording that the browser keeps running describes expected process behavior, not a non-terminating computation.
The task changes configuration options; timeout and control-flow keywords are incidental and do not describe the repaired failure.
The task coordinates duplicate backend loads and request cancellation; a shared load continuing after an individual caller times out is intentional and is not an infinite loop or recursion.
The target concerns attachment-open/download error handling; timeout and Retry-After handling do not constitute an infinite loop or recursion.
Remote images remain in a UI loading state ('never finish loading'), but the application computation does not loop or recurse indefinitely; the patch changes proxy URL loading and fallback behavior.
